player.speaker: Front Commissar
line.reaction-briliant.speaker: Ferenc Julier
line.reaction-briliant.role: Chief of Staff, Hungarian Red Army
line.reaction-briliant.text: Comrade, this army withdrew from Slovakia undefeated. Whatever the government has promised Paris, the formations that crossed back are still capable of an offensive.
line.reaction-tactical.speaker: Ferenc Julier
line.reaction-tactical.role: Chief of Staff, Hungarian Red Army
line.reaction-tactical.text: We gave up Slovakia and gained nothing for it. Stromfeld resigned rather than sign the order, and the staff has not recovered from it.
line.reaction-victory.speaker: Ferenc Julier
line.reaction-victory.role: Chief of Staff, Hungarian Red Army
line.reaction-victory.text: The north has been evacuated. I have the formations, but their officers want to know why they should trust the next government order. I can't ignore that before an offensive.
line.callback-mining-towns.speaker: Jenő Landler
line.callback-mining-towns.text: We held the mining towns to the end and then evacuated them under orders, not under fire. The men have not forgotten the difference.
line.callback-doctrine-methodical.text: Your elastic defence kept the crossings organised and brought formations back. We can use them again. They'll want to hear why this offensive will be different from the victorious ground we just gave up.
line.callback-doctrine-rapid.speaker: Jenő Landler
line.callback-doctrine-rapid.text: The men who counterattacked at Érsekújvár know they weren't driven out of Slovakia. They're angry about withdrawing anyway. The new staff also needs ammunition and replacements for what that attack cost.
line.empty-chair.speaker: Ferenc Julier
line.empty-chair.role: Chief of Staff, Hungarian Red Army
line.empty-chair.text: They've taken Stromfeld's chair out. His pencil marks are still on the maps. When I ask for a report, the officers look at that space first. I need them to work with me, Landler, whether they approve of the withdrawal or not.
line.landler-opening.speaker: Jenő Landler
line.landler-opening.text: Paris promised the Romanians would leave. They haven't. Stromfeld resigned, and now every order gets questioned. We still have formations that can fight. You need to tell their officers what we're asking before distrust makes the decision for us.
line.julier-plan.speaker: Ferenc Julier
line.julier-plan.role: Chief of Staff, Hungarian Red Army
line.julier-plan.text: We cross at several points, with the main effort at Szolnok. The pontoons cannot carry everyone, and Romania expects us. Does the strongest reserve follow that bridgehead at once, or wait centrally for a crossing that proves it can live?
line.julier-plan.choice.szolnok-main.tex: Commit it behind the Szolnok bridgehead and drive deep before the Romanian command can concentrate.
line.julier-plan.choice.szolnok-main.hin: Gain a prestige award and experience for every core formation, but forgo full resupply and the experienced International Brigade.
line.julier-plan.choice.support-flanks.t: Hold the reserve centrally and reinforce whichever crossing gains a secure bridgehead first.
line.julier-plan.choice.support-flanks.h: Fully resupply every core formation and gain an experienced International Brigade, but forgo the deep thrust's prestige and core-wide experience.
line.landler-szolnok.speaker: Jenő Landler
line.landler-szolnok.text: Send engineers, guns and supplies directly after the assault. If the main bridgehead moves quickly, Romania will have to concentrate against it. Don't let the leading divisions get beyond what the bridge can supply.
line.julier-deep-objection.speaker: Ferenc Julier
line.julier-deep-objection.role: Chief of Staff, Hungarian Red Army
line.julier-deep-objection.text: Once it crosses, I have no fresh reserve for a counterattack. I'll send it, Landler. But if the bridgehead stalls, don't ask me for a formation I've already committed.
line.julier-central.speaker: Ferenc Julier
line.julier-central.role: Chief of Staff, Hungarian Red Army
line.julier-central.text: Set the conditions for releasing it now. Otherwise every crossing will call for help and the reserve will spend the battle changing roads.
line.landler-central-objection.speaker: Jenő Landler
line.landler-central-objection.text: Give one commander authority to release it. If we wait for every crossing report to agree, the successful bridgehead may have stopped advancing by the time help arrives.
line.kun-warning.speaker: Béla Kun
line.kun-warning.text: If this fails, Budapest is exposed. I need an army Bucharest and Paris have to reckon with. Tell the soldiers what the crossing requires, not that victory will be easy.
line.julier-final.speaker: Ferenc Julier
line.julier-final.role: Chief of Staff, Hungarian Red Army
line.julier-final.text: Get the first guns over before surprise is gone. Widen only the bridgeheads you can feed, and keep headquarters close enough to know which bridges still exist.
